name: Lincoln Library Cubing 2024

venue.details: The entire library will be in use for the competition, follow the signs.

information:
This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC.

- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LincolnLibraryCubing2024#43495-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LincolnLibraryCubing2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. Additionally, we may make time limits or cutoffs more lenient if the schedule is running well.
